selection.rule: Highest validation macro-F1. The deployed model must also be serialisable without pickle and support exact TreeSHAP; the test split is used only for reporting.

dataset.name: CIC-IDS2017
dataset.citation: Iman Sharafaldin, Arash Habibi Lashkari and Ali A. Ghorbani, "Toward Generating a New Intrusion Detection Dataset and Intrusion Traffic Characterization", ICISSP 2018, pp. 108-116.

selected.name: fwd_pkt_len_std
selected.label: Fwd Packet Length Std
selected.description: Std. dev. of forward packet size

selected.name: bwd_pkt_len_std
selected.label: Bwd Packet Length Std
selected.description: Std. dev. of backward packet size

selected.name: fwd_iat_std
selected.label: Fwd IAT Std
selected.description: Std. dev. of forward inter-arrival time

selected.name: bwd_iat_std
selected.label: Bwd IAT Std
selected.description: Std. dev. of backward inter-arrival time

selected.name: init_win_bytes_fwd
selected.label: Init_Win_bytes_forward
selected.description: Initial TCP window client→server (-1 = not observed)

selected.name: init_win_bytes_bwd
selected.label: Init_Win_bytes_backward
selected.description: Initial TCP window server→client (-1 = not observed)

selected.name: active_mean
selected.label: Active Mean
selected.description: Mean time the flow was active

dropped.destination_port: policy: port-number shortcut; attacks can run on any port

classes.name: DoS
classes.label: Denial of Service
classes.description: Single-source floods and slow-rate exhaustion (Hulk, GoldenEye, Slowloris, SlowHTTPTest).

classes.name: PortScan
classes.label: Port Scan
classes.description: Reconnaissance probing of many ports (Nmap scan types).

classes.name: BruteForce
classes.label: Brute Force
classes.description: Credential guessing against FTP and SSH (Patator).

classes.name: WebAttack
classes.label: Web Attack
classes.description: Application-layer attacks: login brute force, XSS and SQL injection.

classes.name: Bot
classes.label: Botnet
classes.description: Command-and-control traffic of an infected host (Ares botnet).

classes.name: Infiltration
classes.label: Infiltration
classes.description: Post-exploitation activity from an internal compromised host.

isolation_forest.trained_on: 1467165 benign training flows (labels of attacks unused)

calibration.method: temperature scaling fitted on the validation split (minimise NLL)

unseen_attack_probe.note: Heartbleed flows were excluded from training (11 raw flows).

explainability.units: contribution to the temperature-scaled softmax logit

temporal_split.description: Chronological split inside every (capture day, class) block: earliest 70% train, next 15% validation, latest 15% test. Feature selection and preprocessing refitted.

dataset.name: CSE-CIC-IDS2018
dataset.citation: Communications Security Establishment (CSE) & Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity (CIC), CSE-CIC-IDS2018 on AWS, https://registry.opendata.aws/cse-cic-ids2018/
dataset.sampling: at most 40000 flows per (day, label), seed 42, then de-duplicated
